ranking: annual observed freight vehicle-km descending; enterprise_id ascending tie break
within_group_assumption: each selected enterprise electrifies the same representative share q of its freight vehicle-km; freight tailpipe CO2 reduction is proportional to q
targets: minimum integer K in the fixed VKT ranking; this is not a globally optimal enterprise subset
coverage_factor_handling: The input factor is retained as metadata; emissions are not scaled again.
limitations: This analyzes freight-vehicle tailpipe emissions, not steelmaking process emissions.
All freight activity is assumed technically electrifiable; vehicle, charging, grid, cost and adoption constraints are omitted.
Enterprise counts measure implementation coverage, not equal investment or administrative cost.
Freight activity is fixed at 2024; no annual rollout process is modeled.
